key_highlights: ASX booked net weekly gains following an $80b US midterms relief rally, despite late-week pullbacks and steep sector divergence.
Department store icon David Jones entered voluntary administration after landlord talks failed, sparking supply-chain debt contagion and retail REIT vulnerability.
NextDC led technology outperformance on cloud and AI infrastructure demand, contrasting with sharp declines in major banking stocks including NAB.
Qantas flagged a $1B fuel cost headwind, triggering fare hikes and capacity cuts amid broader consumer discretionary spending pressures.
RBA hawkish rhetoric persists, emphasising excess domestic demand and warning unemployment must rise to contain sticky inflation.

sectors.trend: Strong institutional buying in data centres and digital infrastructure offset by restructuring across mature software firms.
sectors.implications: NextDC (NXT.AX) benefits from structural cloud and AI compute tailwinds; however, broader tech faces margin scrutiny as seen in Canva job cuts.

sectors.trend: Severe distress in discretionary department store retail culminating in David Jones' insolvency.
sectors.implications: Commercial landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, GPT.AX) face anchor vacancies, write-downs, and lease renegotiation risks, while unpaid trade suppliers face balance-sheet stress.

sectors.trend: Divergence and sharp selling in major lenders, led by a steep retreat in NAB.
sectors.implications: RBA higher-for-longer policy rates, compressed borrowing capacity, and escalating housing price crash forecasts threaten bank NIMs and loan book credit quality.

sectors.trend: Resurgent equity financing in precious metals and exploration juniors alongside selective critical minerals plays.
sectors.implications: Junior explorers (BPM.AX, CHN.AX, AGC.AX, KNI.AX) and gold capital raisings are absorbing speculative liquidity, supported by precious metal tailwinds and selective lithium exploration.

sectors.trend: Crude oil slump contrasts with severe aviation fuel cost inflation.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces operational margin compression from a $1B fuel surge, requiring fare increases that could erode load factors in a slowing macro backdrop.

key_themes: Macroeconomic divergence between global political relief rallies and deteriorating domestic household balance sheets.
Insolvency contagion across high-profile legacy retail impacting commercial property valuations.
RBA commitment to restrictive policy dampening rate cut expectations and testing mortgage serviceability.
Strong capital rotation into defensive gold miners, exploration juniors, and hyperscale digital infrastructure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commercial Real Estate and Retail Insolvency Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) and avoid suppliers with concentrated exposure to David Jones receivables.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Housing Market and Mortgage Credit Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge exposure to Big Four bank equities (NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX) and construction suppliers via defensive indexing or protective puts.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Jet Fuel Spike and Passenger Demand Elasticity
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce holdings in Qantas (QAN.AX) pending visibility on passenger yields and international capacity rationalisation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Labour Cost Rulings and Regulatory Payroll Tax Liabilities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Audit tech and platform-model holdings for contingent wage liabilities following High Court contractor payroll tax precedents.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Digital Infrastructure and Hyperscale Data Centres
opportunities.rationale: Sustained corporate and AI cloud compute spending insulates data centre operators from domestic consumer deceleration.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Gold Equity Capital Raisings and Discoveries
opportunities.rationale: High gold prices and active broker placement activity provide attractive entry levels into expanding precious metal producers and explorers.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Allocations to Grant-Backed Clean Energy Technology
opportunities.rationale: Sovereign funding and US grant awards provide non-dilutive capital buffers against higher financing hurdles.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Retail REITs and Discretionary Consumer Goods
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones' collapse triggers vacancy risks, rental renegotiation headwinds, and supplier payment default contagion.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim High-Multiple Banking Stocks Facing Mortgage Headwinds
defensive_moves.rationale: Steep drop in NAB and warnings of housing price corrections driven by borrowing capacity limits heighten NIM and bad debt risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reallocate from High-Cost Transports to Defensive Staples and Healthcare
defensive_moves.rationale: Qantas fuel surge of $1B and discretionary consumer squeeze warrant rotation into stable cash-flow generators.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading on the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as post-US midterm relief is counterbalanced by banking weakness and retail insolvencies.
market_outlook.long_term: Persistent RBA hawkishness and mortgage credit constraints will likely slow domestic corporate earnings, favouring resource exporters, gold hedges, and global earners.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate decision
David Jones first creditors meeting and landlord lease renegotiation outcomes
Australian wage price index and labour force unemployment prints
Crude oil benchmark stabilisation and jet fuel refining margin trends
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate movements impacting import costs and resource revenue
Australian residential auction clearance rates and mortgage arrears data
ASX commercial property asset revaluation announcements
Retail supplier inventory liquidation and trade credit insurance conditions
